insights.title: Portfolio acquisition data coverage is incomplete
insights.title_zh: 产品组合的获客数据覆盖不完整
insights.summary: Only Style Atlas has a verified acquisition baseline in Phase 1.
insights.summary_zh: Phase 1 目前只有 Style Atlas 拥有已验证的获客基线。
insights.observation: Only Style Atlas has a verified acquisition baseline in Phase 1.
insights.observation_zh: Phase 1 目前只有 Style Atlas 拥有已验证的获客基线。
insights.evidence: 1 of 5 apps reports first-time downloads; unknown values remain null.
insights.evidence_zh: 5 个应用中只有 1 个上报首次下载；未知值保持为 null。
insights.reason: Portfolio ranking is unreliable without comparable acquisition data.
insights.reason_zh: 缺少可比的获客数据时，产品组合排序不可靠。
insights.recommended_action: Connect or manually import one verified acquisition baseline per app.
insights.recommended_action_zh: 为每个应用接入或手动导入一组已验证的获客基线。
insights.expected_impact_zh: 支持基于证据分配产品投入。
insights.interpretation: Portfolio ranking is unreliable without comparable acquisition data.

insights.title: Build useful static search inventory
insights.title_zh: 建设真正有用的静态搜索内容
insights.summary: Two attributable English pages create the first query-specific inventory.
insights.summary_zh: 两张可归因的英文页面形成首批搜索内容资产。
insights.observation: Style Atlas had no indexable guide or comparison inventory beyond the product page.
insights.observation_zh: 此前除产品页外，Style Atlas 没有可索引的指南或比较页。
insights.evidence: Two attributable English pages were deployed on 2026-08-14.
insights.evidence_zh: 2026-08-14 已上线两张带独立归因的英文页面。
insights.reason: Useful query-specific pages create durable discovery paths and campaign-level attribution.
insights.reason_zh: 针对真实问题的页面可以形成长期发现路径和 campaign 级归因。
insights.recommended_action: Publish one useful guide or comparison page weekly and review search-to-download attribution monthly.
insights.recommended_action_zh: 每周发布一张高质量指南或比较页，并每月复盘搜索到下载的归因。
insights.expected_impact: Incremental qualified product-page views and first-time downloads.
insights.expected_impact_zh: 增加高意向产品页访问与首次下载。
insights.interpretation: Useful query-specific pages create durable discovery paths and campaign-level attribution.

insights.title: Import campaign-level App Store outcomes
insights.title_zh: 导入 campaign 级 App Store 结果
insights.summary: Eight campaign links exist but outcome rows are not recorded.
insights.summary_zh: 8 条 campaign 链接已建立，但尚未录入各自结果。
insights.observation: Campaign links exist for eight channels but per-campaign App Store outcomes are not yet recorded.
insights.observation_zh: 8 个渠道已有独立 campaign 链接，但尚未记录各 campaign 的 App Store 结果。
insights.evidence: Published URLs are known; outbound clicks and first-time downloads are null.
insights.evidence_zh: 公开 URL 已验证；外链点击和首次下载仍为 null。
insights.reason: Engagement cannot identify download-driving channels without outcome imports.
insights.reason_zh: 没有结果导入，仅靠互动无法判断哪个渠道真正带来下载。
insights.recommended_action: Import weekly App Store campaign results and annotate every permanent content URL.
insights.recommended_action_zh: 每周导入 App Store campaign 结果，并关联每条永久内容 URL。
insights.expected_impact: Stops effort on channels that do not produce attributable downloads.
insights.expected_impact_zh: 停止在无法带来可归因下载的渠道上浪费投入。
insights.interpretation: Engagement cannot identify download-driving channels without outcome imports.

actions.rationale: Reuse the weekly guide as a high-quality social asset.
actions.expected_impact: Qualified guide visits and attributable App Store conversions.
actions.approval_source: Active user instruction to continue English image-led publishing when browser accounts permit

actions.title: Refresh Style Atlas data health and attribution readiness
actions.title_zh: 刷新 Style Atlas 数据健康与归因准备状态
actions.description: Recalculate provider freshness, missing metrics, and campaign attribution coverage from verified records.
actions.rationale: A read-only data-health review is the highest-value executable operation while no newer verified App Store snapshot exists.
actions.expected_impact: Prevents decisions from treating unavailable campaign outcomes as zero.
